messages:
nina: Quick thread 1: Spark Systems (HW partner) asked about listing our new LangChain/LlamaIndex gateway adapter in their marketplace and co-announcing with their sales SI partners. Can we map owners and a short checklist?

alex: tech quicknote: adapters are feature-complete but we need a hardware tag for Spark's VCache node and a small tweak to tool-call serialization. Estimate 3 dev days to finish and tests.

james: ops/billing: marketplace listing needs SKU + pricing tier + revenue-share. I'll draft the pricing template but need eng to confirm entitlements.

maria: partnerships: Spark wants a joint webinar the week after listing. BuildForge (SI) wants a hands-on lab. We should offer a sandbox image for them.

samir: I can produce a sandbox AMI/container and a 10-min lab script. Will also capture perf numbers for small/medium configs. ETA 2026-04-10.

loretta: comms: Ill handle blog/social + partner quote requests. Need logo assets and a one-paragraph partner blurb.

legal-bot: Legal flags: co-marketing agreement + logo usage. Also check SDK license compatibility for distributor bundles. Expect 48h review once assets are in.

alex: proposed manifest snippet (inline): connector=spark-gateway-langchain-v1, compat=[langchain>=0.2, llamaindex>=0.6], capabilities=[embeddings, chat, tool-calls], hw_tags=[spark-vcache].

james: ops checklist start: SKU, entitlements map, billing onboarding, revocation procedure, release window. I'll circulate a one-pager.

maria: partner asks for co-sell collateral: one-pager, demo video, and partner quickstart. Samir + Alex can help with demo.

samir: I'll record a 2-min demo and attach lab script. Also include terraform snippet for reproducibility.

deploy-bot: staging slot reserved 2068123600, prod window 2068124000-2068124200.

nina: summary: Alex -> final adapters + tests; Samir -> sandbox + demo + perf; James -> ops + SKU; Loretta -> comms; Maria -> partner liaison; Legal -> agreement review. Sync Friday 09:00 PT to confirm assets. :thumbsup:
